    Coordinates of a simultaneous integer grading #

    A grading by an abelian group (for simultaneous integer weights, ℤʳ) gives an integer grading for each coordinate M →+ ℤ (MGr.coord); their projections preserve each other's homogeneous elements and those of any grading commuting with the ℤʳ-grading (coord_preserve). A ℤ-grading and a commuting grading by an abelian group combine into one grading (MGr.comb), and a finite-dimensional space has a basis homogeneous for both (exists_homBasis_comb).
